title: Canonical ordinary and strict completed pullback normalization data
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its ring of integers $R$ and chosen uniformizer $t$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a scheme morphism $g:Y\to X$. Use the adic datum $R,(t)$, its positive quotient sheaves $R_{T,n}=(R/t^{n+1})_T$ and completed coefficient sheaf $B_T=\varprojlim_n R_{T,n}$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Identify the two published presentations of these sheaves by the fixed finite-projection-normalized coefficient isomorphisms [def-a1-integral-completed-pullback-interfaces]. Write $D_T=D(\operatorname{Mod}(B_T))$, with scalar restriction and its derived scalar-extension adjunctions [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]. Use the canonical completed and finite coefficient inverse-image identifications and ordinary derived pullback of [def-weil-pbc-four-corners], ordinary exact module inverse image of [def-sf-proetale-ring-sheaf-operations], and actual strict quotient-tower completed pullback $g_c^*$ with its specified unit of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback].

Define $\operatorname{modulePull}_g$ to be ordinary module inverse image along the canonical completed coefficient isomorphism. Its identification with the module functor underlying the actual derived pullback is identity on the inverse-image tensor data; the equality on objects and its naturality specify $\operatorname{moduleIso}_g$. Define $\operatorname{derivedIso}_g$ between actual derived pullback and exact termwise ordinary pullback as the unique isomorphism whose whiskering with homotopy localization intertwines the original derived counit and the localization of $\operatorname{moduleIso}_g$.

For $T=X,Y$, define $\operatorname{restrictedReduction}_{T,n}=\operatorname{Res}_{B_T\to R_{T,n}}\circ(-\otimes^L_{B_T}R_{T,n})$, and $\operatorname{reductionUnit}_{T,n}$ to be the unit of that scalar-extension/restriction adjunction. For $a\le b$, define $\operatorname{reductionTransition}_{T,b,a}$ by the canonical quotient $R_{T,b}\to R_{T,a}$ and restriction-of-scalars composition comparison. Define $\operatorname{finiteComparison}_{g,n}$ by the ordinary finite pullback/tensor comparison transported through $\operatorname{derivedIso}_g$, and $\operatorname{restrictedComparison}_{g,n}$ by restricting that finite-coefficient comparison and using the canonical pullback/restriction isomorphism.

Evaluation of the ordinary tower inverse image at $n$ is ordinary inverse image of evaluation; its equality on objects and maps defines $\operatorname{towerEvaluationIso}_{g,n}$ by exact derived descent. Define $\operatorname{completedProjection}_{g,K,n}$ as the actual derived-limit projection of the pulled-back strict reduction tower, followed by this evaluation isomorphism and the specified finite-reduction evaluation map. Define $\operatorname{strictIso}_g$ from the actual strict completed pullback to the published completed pullback as the unique isomorphism carrying its actual unit to $\operatorname{derivedIso}_g$ followed by the published ordinary-to-completed unit. Finally define the actual finite projection by
$$\operatorname{actualCompletedProjection}_{g,K,n}=\operatorname{strictIso}_{g,K}\,;\,\operatorname{completedProjection}_{g,K,n}\,;\,\operatorname{restrictedComparison}_{g,n,K}\,;\,\operatorname{restrictedReduction}_{Y,n}(\operatorname{derivedIso}_{g,K}^{-1}).$$
This node records these existing constructions and their defining characterization helpers, not the theorem that completion is invertible on constructible objects.
